decision.observation: 1 mph, gear 1, all dots dark, no red X. The camera has swung and the car now faces up-screen into pines on grass; the dark tarmac band with white posts runs across the lower-right corner, behind and to the right of the car.
decision.hypothesis: The car has slipped off the outside of the bend again and the lane now lies to its right-rear. Backing up with left steer (the combination that has twice swung the nose toward a lane on the right) should re-aim it at the tarmac.
decision.memory: Camera swings after every turn: re-read the lane each frame. S+A from a rolling state is the reliable way to rotate the nose toward a lane on the right.
